summary: Government-backed guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month starting at age 60.
estimated_total_cost: Monthly auto-debit contribution based on joining age (₹42 – ₹1,454/month)

steps.title: Eligibility check (Age 18–40)
steps.description: Applicant must be an Indian citizen aged between 18 and 40 years, with an active bank savings account.

steps.title: Choose desired pension tier
steps.description: Select monthly pension amount (₹1,000 to ₹5,000) and frequency of contribution (monthly/quarterly).

steps.title: Submit auto-debit authorization
steps.description: Apply via internet banking or submit APY registration form to bank branch authorizing auto-debit.

steps.title: PRAN generation and acknowledgement
steps.description: Receive permanent APY PRAN number and digital subscriber registration slip.

steps.title: Guaranteed pension commencement at age 60
steps.description: Lifelong monthly pension credited on the first of every month post age 60, followed by return of corpus to nominee.
